_comment: xStock ticker -> real, publicly-listed underlying ticker (Stooq/NYSE-Nasdaq symbol). ONLY entries we're confident about are listed - Gap Guard refuses to compute a gap for anything not in this table rather than guess. Deliberately excludes: BRKX, SPCXX, STRCX (mapping not verified with confidence) and the Tessera/PreStocks/Sunrise entries in xstocks.json (OPENAI, KALSHI, ANTHROPIC, MU, ROBOSTRATEGY, SKHY, SNDK, DRAM) - those represent private companies or non-equity instruments with no real NYSE/Nasdaq closing price to compare against, so the whole 'gap vs. real market close' concept doesn't apply to them.
